description: Add up timesheet durations, one per line.

faqs.a: One per line: H:MM (1:30), hours (2h), minutes (45m), seconds (30s) or a bare number which counts as minutes. Prefix with − for negative lines like -0:15.
A bare number is treated as minutes, so "90" adds 1h 30m. This is documented in the steps above.
faqs.q: What does a plain number like 90 mean?

faqs.a: Yes — prefix any line with a minus sign, e.g. -0:15, to subtract a break or correction.

howto: Type one duration per line: 1:30, 2h, 45m, 30s or a bare number (minutes).
Use a leading − for negative lines, e.g. -0:15.
Read the total as h:mm, decimal hours and total minutes.
title: Time Addition Calculator
